eventDetail.scope: AI & Urban Automation – Generative AI, digital twins, computer vision, predictive maintenance, and autonomous systems for city services.  IoT & Connectivity – 5G/6G, edge-to-cloud computing, LPWAN, VANETs, V2X, and wearable tech.  Cybersecurity & Privacy – Zero-trust architectures, blockchain, federated learning, differential privacy, and cryptographic protocols for critical infrastructure.  Big Data & Spatial Analytics – GIS, spatial-temporal mining, real-time stream processing, data fusion, and open data frameworks.  Smart Energy & Sustainability – Renewable microgrids, AI-driven energy management, EV charging, circular economy, waste/water management, and carbon tracking.  Digital Society & Governance – E-government, FinTech, digital inclusion, disaster response, and smart logistics.
